subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers accept a proof override for this Feishu streaming-card fix, or require a rebased repair with live or sanctioned CardKit proof before merge?
rationale: The external contributor states they lack a live Feishu tenant and DeepSeek streaming setup, while ClawSweeper cannot treat helper console output and mocked tests as sufficient proof for a visible Feishu CardKit change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override Proof After Verification
options.body: A maintainer with Feishu access can explicitly own the proof gap after verifying the rebased branch through a sanctioned tenant or equivalent capture.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current live assignee and a recent Feishu-area contributor, so they are the best available owner for proof override or branch disposition.
